title: IEA EBC Annex 79 final report and occupant-behavior model guideline
version: Final report October 2024 and guideline retrieved 2026-08-11
publisher: IEA Energy in Buildings and Communities Programme

doi.absence_reason: The final report identifies ISBN 978-1-4884-0041-4 but no DOI.

measurement_uncertainty.description: The registered publications synthesize methods and case studies; they are not a single measurement series.

known_gaps: The reports guide documentation and evaluation but do not establish a NexusEP calibration result.
Linked databases and individual case studies require separate source, license, uncertainty, and split records.
Many reported applications remain proof-of-concept; real-building transfer must be tested independently.

preprocessing.description: Verify both retrieved PDFs and checksums without redistributing extracted content.

permitted_use.purpose: Methodological guidance for transparent occupant-model documentation, diversity, and domain-specific evaluation.
permitted_use.notes: Keep source PDFs in ignored raw storage and register any later empirical dataset separately.
